name: search-visibility-kit
description: Connect Claude to Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 and IndexNow for any website. Guided credential setup, data-driven SEO audits, sitemap health checks, and IndexNow submission with real verification.

google_sa_key_path.title: Google service account key
google_sa_key_path.description: The JSON key file of the Google Cloud service account that has read access to your Search Console and GA4 properties. Run the setup-google-access skill if you do not have one yet.

google_cloud_project_id.title: Google Cloud project ID
google_cloud_project_id.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that owns the service account (shown in the key file as project_id).
